nom: SUNDAY RILEY TIDAL Deep Hydration & Plumping Serum

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one with dry, acne-prone skin, report the serum is strongly hydrating and describe it as a game changer for dryness, especially in cold weather.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination skin reports the serum provides adequate moisture without making her skin greasy.
segments.sensitive: Reports from reviewers describing sensitive skin are split: several say the serum did not irritate them and call it gentle, but multiple other reviewers, including some with no prior history of product reactions, report burning, hives, itchy bumps or inflammation severe enough to stop use, in at least one case confirmed by a repeat patch test.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 40s reports fewer visible fine lines and wrinkles after two weeks of daily use, and another describes the serum restoring elasticity to loose, aging skin over the colder months.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers describe the serum as strongly hydrating, leaving skin soft, plump and smooth, including in cold or dry conditions; one reviewer dissents, reporting it absorbed too quickly and left her skin drier rather than more hydrated.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report burning, redness, hives, itchy bumps or inflammation after applying the serum, in some cases spreading to the neck and confirmed by a repeat patch test on the cheek; many other reviewers, including some who describe their skin as generally sensitive or reactive to new products, report no irritation at all.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: one reviewer with dry, acne-prone skin reports no breakouts and improved hydration, while two other reviewers describe their skin purging or breaking out badly in the first weeks of use, with purging settling down for one of them after continued use.
concerns.aging: A small number of reviewers report fewer visible fine lines and wrinkles, and one describes the serum restoring elasticity to loose, aging skin, after two or more weeks of use; most other reviewers focus on hydration rather than aging-specific effects.

aspects.libelle: A little product goes a long way

extraits.titre: Burned my face!!! NOT for sensitive skin!
extraits.texte: I used this serum and a few moments later my face is burning and red! NOT sensitive skin friendly!!! This is the only product from sunday riley ive ever had this reaction to.

I am an avid user of Sunday Riley products. I loved the old tidal moisturizer when it was out. I bought this as I was excited about the name returning. I put this on in the morning, and hours later my entire face and neck broke out in itchy hives. nothing else in my routine had changed at all, except using this serum. not sure genuinely how many stars to give or not give (I settled on two because having hives at work isn't my idea of fun?) but just wanted to share my experience in the event this happens to others!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] For starters the smell, I didn't exactly mind it but it does have a very "green" smell to it I don't know how else to describe it. The packaging was nice although I feel for the price it should have more product. I wish I could say I liked it better than my normal serum but I felt like this one immediately soaks in and my skin doesn't really get hydrated and ends up drying my skin more. All in all I don't think I'll be reaching to buy this product anytime soon.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product is great and very hydrating especially in the cold dry winter weather! It has been a game changer and I would definitely recommend to anyone with dry acne prone skin! It absorbs very nicely into the skin and leaves you looking very hydrated without being heavy. The only downfall is the smell. It's not overpowering it's kind of like play dough, which isn't my favorite. Great product and I love the pump!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This was my first time using anything from this brand, and it definitely exceeded my expectations. The packing is nice and serum is good consistency. It has sort of like a chemical smell to it but I don't notice it anymore. I'm usually very sensitive to new products, but this serum didn't irritate my skin at all. It hydrated my skin really well and left it feeling soft and healthy. Overall, I'm really happy with it and would definitely recommend it!

extraits.titre: moisture without greasiness- perfect base for makeup
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Sunday Riley with another A+++ product! I have been in search of a product that would function as a moisturizer/serum AND a primer. I don't even think this is marketed as such, but it absolutely fits the bill! This product has the texture of a serum, but is not runny. The dry down is quick and does not leave a sticky residue behind (huge plus for me because I don't like to wait a long time for my products to dry; I'm generally in a hurry! Lol). I have combination skin and this product provides adequate moisture without making my skin greasy. I absolutely love this product and can't think of any skin type that wouldn't love it as well

extraits.titre: A tiny drop restored my moisture and improved elasticity.
extraits.texte: During these colder months when my skin usually feels dry and dehydrated, this hydrating serum has truly brought the moisture back. My skin looks refreshed and glowy again! I also never knew that as I got older and started noticing some loose skin, a serum could actually help restore the elasticity in my face and neck, but this one really has. You only need a tiny amount because it goes a long way, and my face feels so soft and smooth after applying it. Highly recommend for anyone needing a boost of hydration and firmness this season! I received this product in exchange for my honest review
